references.text: Joshua conquered Libna earlier in his campaign against the southern Canaanite kings, where the city and its king were defeated.
Joshua captured Debir after taking Libna as part of the southern campaign.
Libna is mentioned as one of the cities assigned to the tribe of Judah.
Libna was given to the descendants of Aaron as a Levitical city.
David hid in the cave at Adullam when he fled from Saul.
The Assyrian king Sennacherib besieged Libna, confirming the city's continued existence.
Adullam is mentioned among the places where David's mighty men gathered.
The prophet Micah mentions Adullam in his prophecy concerning the cities of Judah.
